topics.definition: Data cleaning removes errors, duplicates and inconsistent values from datasets.
tips: Check for missing and incorrect values.

topics.definition: Missing values can be removed or replaced using suitable techniques.
topics.example: Replace missing age with mean value
tips: Choose an imputation method based on the dataset.

topics.definition: Normalization scales data to a common range for better model performance.
Transformation converts data into a suitable format for analysis.
Outlier detection identifies unusual observations in data.
Categorical values are converted into numerical form for machine learning.
tips: Use one-hot encoding for nominal categories.

topics.definition: A dataset is divided into training and testing sets to evaluate models.
tips: Avoid using test data during training.

topics.definition: Prepare data carefully before model training to improve accuracy.
